daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. Don't sleep on that thought that popped into your head this morning—it has legs. This is peak energy for pitching, proposing, or pivoting toward something that actually excites you.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement over intensity. A walk, a stretch, something that lets you think—that's the real medicine right now. Hydration and good snacks are your subtle power moves today.

weekly.love: Singles, someone's about to catch your vibe in the most unexpected way. If you're coupled up, this is perfect timing to actually say the vulnerable stuff you've been sitting on. Real recognizes real.
